content: उपसंहारः .²1 Drawing in or together, contracting; क्रियतामुपसंहारो गुर्वर्थं द्विजसत्तम <ls>Mb. 5. 116. 13</ls>. .²2 Drawing away, withdrawing, excluding, withholding. अजानन्नुपसंहारं प्राणकृच्छ्रमुपस्थिते <ls>Bhāg. 1. 7. 20</ls>. .²3 A collection, assemblage; न तु धर्मोपसंहारमधर्मफलसंहितम् <ls>Rām. 5. 51 28</ls>. .²4 Summing up, winding up, conclusion (<ab>opp.</ab> उपक्रम). .²5 A preparation (of a speech <ab>&c.</ab>). .²6 A compendium, resume. .²7 Brevity, conciseness. .²8 Perfection. .²9 Destruction, death, end. .²10 Attacking, invading. .²11 (In logic) Refutation. .²12 <ab>N.</ab> of the concluding chapters in several books.
